It has been represented in the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] since 1916 and earlier in the [[Philippine Assembly]] from 1907 to 1916.{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |title=Roster of Philippine legislators |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=April 30, 2020}} The district consists of the City of [[Urdaneta, Pangasinan|Urdaneta]] and adjacent municipalities of [[Alcala, Pangasinan|Alcala]], [[Bautista, Pangasinan|Bautista]], [[Binalonan]], [[Laoac]], [[Pozorrubio, Pangasinan|Pozorrubio]], [[Santo Tomas, Pangasinan|Santo Tomas]], [[Sison, Pangasinan|Sison]], and [[Villasis, Pangasinan|Villasis]]. Prior to its second dissolution in 1972, it consisted of the eastern municipalities of [[Asingan]], [[Balungao]], [[Natividad, Pangasinan|Natividad]], [[Rosales, Pangasinan|Rosales]], [[San Manuel, Pangasinan|San Manuel]], [[San Nicolas, Pangasinan|San Nicolas]], [[San Quintin, Pangasinan|San Quintin]], [[Santa Maria, Pangasinan|Santa Maria]], [[Tayug]], and [[Umingan]], now comprising the [[Pangasinan's 6th congressional district|6th district]] since 1987. It is currently represented in the [[20th Congress of the Philippines|20th Congress]] by [[Ramon Guico Jr.]] of the [[Lakas–CMD]] (Lakas).{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/members/ |title=House Members |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=April 30, 2020}} ==Representation history== {| class=wikitable |- ! rowspan="2" | # ! rowspan="2" colspan=2 | Image ! rowspan="2" | Member ! colspan=2 | Term of office ! rowspan="2" | Legislature ! rowspan="2" | Party ! rowspan="2" | Electoral history ! rowspan="2" | Constituent
